account:
Today has mostly followed my appointments: market in the morning, lunch at home, town accounts, and tea with my neighbour at the east-bank dockside cottage. It is now 16:00, and I need to return for my 16:30 office appointment. The treasury contained 128 emeralds; I reported that to the secretary. The secretary also confirmed my tea arrangements.

The most noticeable recurring news concerns the baker. Several townsfolk told me they had seen the baker carrying a sack of bread at the inn, and later at the north plaza. I also personally saw freight give the baker an emerald at 14:09. This could simply be bread sales or deliveries. I have not seen enough to establish an unusual purpose, and repeated reports may just be the same news circulating rather than separate incidents.

At tea, my neighbour mentioned hearing of a possible bridge or port change. They had no details and explicitly regarded it as unverified chatter. I know of no confirmed plans and cannot say who originated it or what the change would be for. I told my neighbour I would ask at the office rather than spread the rumour. The secretary is the sensible person to ask when I return. Nothing I have observed establishes a connection between this rumour and the baker's movements.
